description: Open the 'Sample House' project in NCH DreamPlan. Locate the master bedroom on the main floor plan. Resize the bedroom by selecting the interior wall shared with the hallway/adjacent room and moving it outward to increase the room's width by approximately 2 feet (making it roughly 14 feet wide). Verify the room looks larger in the 2D Blueprint view and save the project.

vlm_criteria.wall_selection_visible: Agent selects an interior wall of the bedroom
vlm_criteria.room_expansion_visible: The bedroom area visibly increases in size
vlm_criteria.blueprint_view_used: Agent uses 2D Blueprint view for precision
